rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a violent funnel-shaped storm that reaches the ground.

example.english: There was a tornado in the US yesterday, and it knocked down a lot of houses.
example.traditional: 尋日美國有條龍捲風，吹冧咗好多間屋。
example.jyutping: cam4 jat6 mei5 gwok3 jau5 tiu4 lung4 gyun2 fung1 ceoi1 lam1 zo2 hou2 do1 gaan1 uk1
